def anchors(self, path):
        if not _path(path): _fail('publication_path')
        alias = self._alias() if path.startswith('/var/volatile/tmp/') else None
        scope = self.attempt
        metadata = (type(scope) is _StartupReadScope and len(path.split('/')) - 1 > 2 and
            (path.startswith(ASSET_PHYSICAL_ROOT + '/') or
             path.startswith('/usr/') or path.startswith('/proc/')))
        clock = functions = codes = None
        rows = []
        for index in range(len(path.split('/')) - 1):
            name = '/' if index == 0 else '/' + '/'.join(path.split('/')[1:index + 1])
            if not metadata or index == 0:
                self.attempt.now()
                if metadata:
                    clock, functions, codes = scope._alias_clock, scope._alias_functions, scope._alias_codes
            else:
                # Only the retained Startup metadata method may run here.
                # Recheck before each call: the preceding stat may have changed it.
                if (self.attempt is not scope or type(scope) is not _StartupReadScope or
                        scope.files is not self or scope._files_original is not self or
                        scope._alias_functions is not functions or functions is not _STARTUP_ALIAS_ORIGINALS or
                        type(functions) is not tuple or len(functions) != 6 or
                        scope._alias_codes is not codes or codes is not _STARTUP_ALIAS_CODES or
                        type(codes) is not tuple or len(codes) != 6 or
                        type(clock) is not types.MethodType or scope._alias_clock is not clock or
                        type(self.alias_owner) is not _F_ORIGINALS[4] or self.alias_owner.clock is not clock or
                        clock.__self__ is not scope or clock.__func__ is not functions[3] or
                        type(functions[3]) is not types.FunctionType or
                        _StartupReadScope.__dict__.get('alias_now') is not functions[3] or
                        functions[3].__code__ is not codes[3]):
                    _fail('startup_owner_changed')
                clock()
            meta = executor._meta(os.stat(name, follow_symlinks=False))
            temporary = alias is not None and name in ('/var/volatile', '/var/volatile/tmp')
            if name == '/mnt/data':
                held = self.attempt.received_directory.identity_rows()
                if (self.attempt.received_directory.check() is not self.attempt.received_directory or
                        type(held) is not tuple or len(held) != 6 or
                        held[2] != ('data', 66328, 21, stat.S_IFDIR | 0o755, 1000, 1000) or
                        meta[:5] != held[2][1:]): _fail('publication_path')
            elif (not stat.S_ISDIR(meta[2]) or meta[3:5] != (0, 0) or
                    meta[2] & 0o022 and not temporary): _fail('publication_path')
            if (name == ASSET_PHYSICAL_ROOT or name.startswith(ASSET_PHYSICAL_ROOT + '/')) and stat.S_IMODE(meta[2]) != 0o700:
                _fail('publication_asset_mode')
            rows.append((name, meta[:5]))
        if metadata:
            if self.attempt is not scope: _fail('startup_owner_changed')
            self.attempt.now()
        return alias, tuple(rows)
